Our Story

About Animoro

Your Daily Dose of Anime

Animoro is the publisher name used across this website. The site brings anime editorial coverage together with catalogue and schedule features.

Readers can explore anime news, reviews, rankings, guides, recommendations, seasonal articles, and manga coverage. The site also provides an anime list, upcoming-anime listings, and an airing schedule.

What We Stand For

  • Anime News: Browse the Anime News archive for coverage and announcements.
  • Editorial Articles: Explore reviews, rankings, guides, recommendations, manga coverage, and seasonal articles.
  • Anime Discovery: Search the anime catalogue and open titles for available series details.
  • Release Information: Visit Upcoming Anime and Anime Airing Today for available listing and schedule information.

Animoro's article archive includes news, reviews, rankings, guides, recommendations, manga coverage, and seasonal anime articles.
